note: NEW FAMILY (v0.6.0, hand-authored spec fixture — Rust-native, no Flask recording exists; DECISIONS.md 2026-08-24). SEEDING (fresh DB, self-host login, in this order): 1) POST /api/mood {mood: 4, date: "2025-08-01", content: "Great workout day.", selected_options: [1, 5]} (default seeded options 1=Emotions/happy, 5=Emotions/content); 2) POST /api/mood {mood: 2, date: "2025-08-02", content: "Rough night."}; 3) POST /api/goals {title: "Meditate", description: "10 minutes", frequency_per_week: 3} then POST /api/goals/1/progress with no date (logs today); 4) POST /api/goals {title: "Read", frequency_per_week: 2}. Object envelope, exactly four top-level keys: schema_version (pinned integer 1), exported_at (SQLite-style UTC "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" -> <TS>), app_version (CARGO_PKG_VERSION -> <VERSION>, same substitution as config_get_200.json), data {entries, goals}. NO ids and NO user_id anywhere — they are not portable (fresh DBs pre-seed 3 groups / 27 options). Selections are denormalized by exact name as {group_name, option_name} pairs, ordered like GET /api/mood/{id}/selections (group name, then option name — hence content before happy). Deterministic order is contract: entries ascending by date (id-order tiebreak), goals in creation order. Goal weekly state (completed/streak/period_start) is exported raw with the rollover projected exactly as the goals GETs project it — the export is a pure read and persists nothing. Volatile values normalized: timestamps -> <TS>, bare YYYY-MM-DD dates -> <DATE> (the goals-family convention; the concrete seed dates are in this note).
